changelog:
Initial release of fuxin-batch-undo — 福昕 Office 批次撤销技能:

- Enables batching of multiple Office write actions into a single transaction for one-step undo (Ctrl+Z)
- Supports both implicit (default per-call) and explicit (manual begin/end batch) workflows
- Provides lifecycle management and user guidance for batch operations and undo actions
- Integrates with FuxinAiService and fuxin-office-bridge for operation routing and pre-checks
- Ensures batch undo applies across Word, Excel, and PowerPoint write actions
display_name: 福昕 Office 文档回溯
summary: 福昕 Office 文档回溯是 Office Skills 的安全网。当 AI 在多个 Office 应用中执行了多步操作，用户可以一次性选择回退到某个历史节点，而不用逐个应用手动撤销。它以事务方式记录操作链，确保文档状态一致恢复，适合需要高可控性的工作场景。
